copy.tagline: 实现CQRS架构，分离读写模型以提升系统扩展性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或重构后端架构,需要分离读写模型来应对高并发查询。
copy.tagline_en: Implement CQRS to separate read and write models for scalable architectures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing or refactoring backend architecture to handle high-concurrency reads and writes.

howto.what: Claude 会按 CQRS 模式帮你把系统拆成写入端和读取端:命令与查询分别走各自的 API 和处理器,写入模型通过事件更新读取模型。需要具体模板时它会去读 references/details.md。
howto.when: 当你需要分离读写模型、优化查询性能,或构建事件溯源系统时会触发;正文也把它定位为处理复杂查询、需要独立读写数据模型的场景。

howto.what_en: Claude applies CQRS to split your system into a write side and a read side: commands and queries go through separate APIs and handlers, and the write model feeds the read model via events. It reads references/details.md for templates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you separate read and write models, optimize query performance, or build event-sourced systems.
